subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept private-network authority from both browser.ssrfPolicy and models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork, or only the provider-scoped request setting?
rationale: Both choices are technically implementable, but they define how a deliberately dangerous browser policy crosses into model-provider network traffic and therefore require repository owner intent.

options.title: Allow Both Explicit Opt-ins
options.body: Approve the current authorization model, then require current-head provider-path proof for default denial, browser-policy authorization, and provider-request authorization.

options.title: Keep Authorization Provider-Scoped
options.body: Remove the browser-policy hook and allow private xAI image endpoints only through models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork.

options.title: Pause the Change
options.body: Leave xAI image generation fail-closed until a narrower origin-scoped provider policy is designed and proved.

recommendation.title: Allow Both Explicit Opt-ins
recommendation.body: Approve the current authorization model, then require current-head provider-path proof for default denial, browser-policy authorization, and provider-request authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to both the xAI provider merge and the shared factory where the authorization contract is enforced.
